# ReelCut MCP

> Token-efficient local 9:16 Arabic video editing pipeline & MCP server for Windows (CPU-only) and AI agents.

## Docs
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Complete guide for AI agents (workflow, token rules, module map, verification).
- [README.md](README.md): Installation, Windows setup, CLI commands, and MCP configuration.
- [docs/MCP_TOOLS.md](docs/MCP_TOOLS.md): Exact MCP tool signatures, EditPlan JSON schema, and outputs.
- [.agents/skills/reelcut/SKILL.md](.agents/skills/reelcut/SKILL.md): Agent skill runbook for automated reel editing.

## Examples
- [examples/sample_script.txt](examples/sample_script.txt): Sample colloquial Arabic script with source URLs.
- [examples/sample_plan.json](examples/sample_plan.json): Valid EditPlan JSON with zoom cuts and source QR overlays.
- [mcp_config.example.json](mcp_config.example.json): Stdio MCP configuration template.
